messages:
Ravi: Proposal: a compact 'admit_score' from bench to simplify controller decisions. single scalar + short tag list.
Lina: Single scalar ok, but include top-3 failure tags so owners know why.
Omar: bench can emit admit_score 0-100 and tags like latency_p95, mem_headroom, tokenizer_mismatch, cost_delta. cheap to compute.
Priya: Policy: >=80 auto-canary, 60-79 require human, <60 reject. thresholds configurable.
QA-Jen: Tests: borderline flows, ensure UI explains top contributing tags and shows metric breakdown.
Kai: For big models, golden replay optional; make golden_required flag in model manifest.
Ravi: Scoring funcs are pluggable per-metric; defaults provided. owners can override.
Omar: Multi-shard: bench should include worst_shard_id and factor into score so bad shards don't get masked.
Priya: Controller mapping: accept -> 1% canary + 10m watch; manual -> notify owner; reject -> halt intake and attach rollback tips.
QA-Jen: Telemetry: emit admit_score low-cardinality. on failure upload full artifact for triage.
ops-bot: noted: will page owner if admit_score drops >30 between runs.
Ravi: Rollout: opt-in for 4 weeks, then flip default for new models. I'll open PR with schema + scoring helpers.
Lina: Also add a Console visualizer showing per-metric contribution.
Ravi: thanks all :)
